title: World Models for Ocean Engineering: A Critical Review of Maritime Autonomy, Adaptive Latent Prediction, Digital Twins, and Biodiversity Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2611.28978v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Marine robots face partial observability, non-stationary dynamics, and sparse communication, motivating WMs that learn compact predictive states for planning. This review develops a functional taxonomy of WMs for ocean engineering, focusing on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) and AdaJEPA's test-time adaptation within model predictive control, mapping them to navigation, adaptive sampling, digital twins, and biodiversity monitoring, and separating demonstrated evidence from prospective applications. The synthesis identifies key Gaps: benchmarks, uncertainty calibration, safe adaptation and proposes a research agenda for physics-informed, deployment-adaptive marine WMs validated through simulation and field missions.

translated_title: 面向海洋工程的世界模型：海洋自主、自适应潜空间预测、数字孪生与生物多样性监测的批判性综述
translated_abstract: 海洋机器人面临部分可观测性、非平稳动力学和稀疏通信等挑战，这促使世界模型（WM）学习紧凑的预测状态以支持规划。本综述为海洋工程中的世界模型建立了一个功能性分类体系，重点聚焦联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）以及AdaJEPA在模型预测控制中的测试时自适应能力，将其映射到导航、自适应采样、数字孪生和生物多样性监测等应用领域，并将已验证的证据与前瞻性潜在应用区分开来。该综合分析识别出关键的研究空白：基准测试、不确定性校准和安全自适应，并提出了一项面向物理信息驱动、部署自适应的海洋世界模型的研究议程，通过仿真和实地任务加以验证。
tldr: 本综述为海洋工程领域建立了世界模型的功能性分类体系，聚焦JEPA架构及AdaJEPA的测试时自适应能力，识别出基准测试、不确定性校准和安全自适应等关键研究空白，并提出了物理信息驱动、部署自适应的海洋世界模型研究议程。
